meta.purpose: Pre-layout bench kit for OI-24, OI-27, OI-28 (V-MEAS-00, bench M) and OI-31 (V-MEAS-06, bench A), plus the CH335F module measurement (bench C). Hardware is WIP; nothing here is for a manufactured board.

sources.akizuki: Product pages akizukidenshi.com/catalog/g/g<code>/ downloaded 2026-11-03; every Akizuki price, stock figure, pack size and code below was read from that day's page.
sources.design: design/circuit/CIRCUIT_DESIGN_Rev0.4.md (sections 3.2, 6.1, 6.4, 12); requirements/parts.md; requirements/verification.md (V-MEAS-00, V-MEAS-06); CLAUDE.md section 11 (OI-24, OI-27, OI-28, OI-31)
sources.lcsc: Product pages https://www.lcsc.com/product-detail/C7433.html and https://www.lcsc.com/product-detail/C15127.html downloaded 2026-11-03; code, MPN, brand, package, stock, minimum order and the price tier were read from the page's embedded product JSON. LCSC's shipping charge to Japan was not read: LCSC shows it at checkout.

items.title: 電解コンデンサー22μF50V105℃ ルビコンPX
items.note: Aluminium electrolytic on the AZ1117 output (V3V3, bench A). The design has a 22 uF 25 V ceramic here (C45783); an electrolytic is kept because the 1117 family's stability on a ceramic alone is still unconfirmed (parts.md, AMS1117 'To confirm'), and an oscillating V3V3 would corrupt VREF. Its higher ESR enters no reading.

items.title: 電解コンデンサー10μF50V105℃ ルビコンPX
items.note: Aluminium electrolytic in the V5A filter (bench A, the MCP3208's VDD). The design has 10 uF 25 V X5R 0805 (C15850). A supply filter: its higher ESR and the missing DC-bias derating enter no V-MEAS-06 reading.

items.title: チップ積層セラミックコンデンサー 22μF25V X5R 2012
items.note: Murata GRM21BR61E226ME44: 22 uF 25 V X5R 0805, the design's value, rating, dielectric and size (C45783, another maker). Used for V12F, where ESR and DC-bias derating set the OP07's supply filter. Solder on univ-pcb.

items.title: チップ積層セラミックコンデンサー 10μF25V B 2012
items.note: Murata GRM21BB31E106KA73: 10 uF 25 V, JIS B (class 2, +/-10 % over -25..85 C), 0805, like the design's X5R C15850 (another maker). It is the port capacitor: its low ESR and its DC-bias derating (the design assumes about 7 uF at 5 V) shape the 0.1 -> 1 A step that V-MEAS-00 judges for overshoot. An electrolytic would damp that step and could hide ringing. Solder on univ-pcb at VBUS_A.

not_at_akizuki.why: Akizuki's OP07 search returns only PDIP-8 parts, e.g. ADI's OP07CPZ (g113696): another vendor's die. OI-27 is about this die's single-supply common mode and output low, so a result on another die cannot close it.
not_at_akizuki.alternative: item op07cdr: the exact part from LCSC (C7433, the same LCSC item JLCPCB places), on an SOP-8 adapter (item adp-sop8).

not_at_akizuki.why: Akizuki lists no AO3401. Its nearest P-FET, IRLML6402 (g102553), has V_GS(th) -0.40/-0.55/-1.2 V against the AO3401A's -0.5/-0.9/-1.3 V, so OI-27's gate-headroom result would not transfer.
not_at_akizuki.alternative: item ao3401a: the exact part from LCSC (C15127), on an SOT-23 adapter.

not_at_akizuki.why: AMS1117 search returned no exact listing.
not_at_akizuki.alternative: item az1117: AZ1117CH-3.3TRG1, the Diodes-Inc AMS1117-equivalent in SOT-223.
item tl431: HTC TL431 in TO-92, the same TL431-type shunt function.

not_at_akizuki.design_part: through-hole logic-level N-MOSFET, RDS(on) specified at VGS <= 3.3 V
not_at_akizuki.why: Every stocked through-hole candidate specifies RDS(on) only at >= 4.0 V gate drive: 2SK2232 and 2SK4017 at 4 V, TK8S06K3L at 6 V, IRLB3813/IRLB3034 at 4.5 V, IRLU3410 at 4.0 V, PSMN015N10NS2 at 6 V (datasheets read 2026-11-03).
not_at_akizuki.alternative: item irlml6344: SOT-23, RDS(on) 37 mOhm max at VGS = 2.5 V. Second candidate MTN2306AN3 (g117513, 28 mOhm @2.5 V, SOT-23, pack of 10) not purchased.

not_at_akizuki.design_part: 27 ohm series resistor, contingency for the OI-31 USB check
not_at_akizuki.why: Not bought: the PGA2040 schematic shows R1/R2 = 27R4 already fitted on USB_DP/USB_DM; the bench only measures them. No 1 % metal-film 27 ohm exists at Akizuki anyway.
not_at_akizuki.alternative: if the module measures open: 1/4W27Ω carbon g114273 (bag of 100), or a 22+4.7 ohm series pair from the bought bags.

instruments.role: port supply for the V-MEAS-00 sweep at 4.59 V and 5.25 V, and for the R_M pulse (set so that R_M sees 4.85 V)
instruments.spec: adjustable CV supply covering 4.5-5.5 V at >= 1.5 A (the resistor fallback draws up to 1.43 A at 5.25 V)
instruments.fallback: a fixed 5 V >= 1.5 A brick cannot reach 4.59 V; run the 5.25 V point only and record the gap

instruments.role: 5 V rail for the MAU104 input on bench M (the design feeds U5 from V5L, J1's 5 V). Bench A takes its 5 V from the PC's USB port instead (see pc).
instruments.fallback: second channel of the bench supply

instruments.role: V-MEAS-00 output/gate voltages; reference for the V-MEAS-06 sweep
instruments.spec: >= 40,000 counts, i.e. 0.1 mV on a 4 V range (a 4 3/4- or 5 1/2-digit meter); 0.5 LSB at VREF 3.3 V = 0.40 mV; two meters ease the ADC-vs-input compare
instruments.fallback: a 4,000- or 20,000-count meter shows 1 mV at 3.3 V (1.2 LSB): INL is then resolved to about +/-0.6 LSB, so a result within 1 LSB of the +/-2 LSB limit is inconclusive. A 2,000-count meter shows 10 mV at 3.3 V and cannot run this check.

instruments.role: R_M = 10 ohm within +/-0.1 % after the pulse test (OI-28)
instruments.spec: 4-wire ohms with <= 1 mOhm resolution at 10 ohm (a 0.1 % change is 10 mOhm)
instruments.fallback: manual 4-wire: force about 20 mA through R_M from the bench supply via a series resistor, read the current on one DMM and the voltage at the resistor body on another (0.2 V, 4 mW); R = V / I, same meters, ranges and current before and after the pulses

instruments.role: ringing on the 0.1 -> 1 A step; gate/output timing on bench M
instruments.spec: >= 50 MHz, 2 channels (mirror output node + FET gate; R_M voltage in the pulse)

instruments.role: 0 -> 1.2 A sweep and the 0.1 -> 1 A step (V-MEAS-00)
instruments.spec: electronic load 0-1.5 A with a step <= 10 us
instruments.fallback: power resistors: 47 ohm >= 1 W (0.10-0.11 A), 10 ohm >= 5 W (0.45-0.52 A), 4.7 ohm >= 10 W (0.96-1.09 A), and for the 1.2 A end that same 4.7 ohm || a 15 ohm >= 3 W (1.25-1.43 A); ranges are 4.59-5.25 V through the 0.1 ohm shunt. The step always goes through M7; read the actual current on the meter.

instruments.role: CH335F module outline and hole grid (OI-24)
instruments.fallback: steel rule at 0.5 mm - record reduced precision

instruments.role: firmware builds (UF2), CDC-ACM enumeration, flash unique-ID check; its USB port powers bench A through the usbc-kit VBUS (about 0.1 A)
instruments.spec: a PC that builds RP2040 firmware, plus a USB port that supplies 5 V at >= 0.1 A
instruments.fallback: a PC that cannot build RP2040 firmware can still flash a UF2 built elsewhere (BOOTSEL drive) and run a serial terminal

instruments.role: assemble the DIP kits, adapters and Kelvin wiring
instruments.spec: soldering iron + solder; a fine tip for the SOT-23 adapters and the 6.3 mm shunt chip
instruments.fallback: no clip-on substitute exists for the SOT-23/SOP-8 adapters or the Kelvin shunt joints: without a fine tip, have them soldered elsewhere (a makerspace) before the bench
